title: Stellar XLM Holders Will Be the New 1% – Surpasses SHIB & Eyes Top 10 Crypto Spot
description:

How Stellar flipped SHIB in market cap & what it means for the entire crypto market

Why XLM holders are now in position to be the early elite of the next financial era
